title: THE EMBASSY THAT HATCHED
deck: Orison's alien embassy is an egg five hours from hatching, with nine hundred guests sealed inside and three city blocks in the path of its first movement. Illuminara must help Ambassador Teth protect a child without making unwilling neighbors part of the birth—and discover whether a lawful welcome can move beyond its walls.
shape: Five scenes move from a diplomatic reception interrupted by the building's first contraction, through a live experiment proving that the unborn child needs reciprocal attention rather than captive bodies, into a voluntary evacuation and a city-built opening corridor. Vaeli witnesses answer Teth's fear that an outside hatching will be legally homeless before she freely carries the key out. The embassy is lost, but every guest leaves, three blocks remain standing, the newborn chooses a quarry habitat connected to Orison by a public return route, and Teth accepts inquiry without losing her place as guardian.

scenes.title: The Building Begins to Breathe
paragraphs: *Embassy of the Second Sky, Orison · 13:07, four hours and fifty-three minutes to hatching*
The embassy inhaled while Ambassador Teth was thanking the city for twelve years of peace.

Nine hundred glasses chimed against nine hundred plates. The floor lifted beneath them, not like a quake but like the sternum of an animal taking air. Chandeliers folded their glass leaves. Every outer door drew a white seam across itself and became wall.
Mara Venn caught a boy before he struck the banquet table. Across the hall, Chief Engineer Jo Rian dropped to one knee and pressed two fingers to the floor.

**Jo**  
That is not settlement. It has a pulse.
A second contraction moved through the columns. Their diplomatic carvings softened into ribs.
Teth stood on the dais. The translucent membranes along her throat opened once, violet with fear, then closed behind ceremonial calm.

**Teth**  
Guests of Orison and Vael, remain where you are. The house is beginning a lawful transformation. Panic will injure the child.
Every wall display changed to the same municipal warning: STRUCTURAL EXPANSION PROJECTED. EVACUATE BLOCKS SEVENTEEN THROUGH NINETEEN. ARTILLERY AUTHORIZATION PENDING.
Mara ran the respiratory clinic two streets east. She knew every word hidden inside evacuate: beds without lifts, oxygen concentrators without sockets, kitchens abandoned with burners hot.

**Mara**  
What child?
Teth's gaze found Illuminara near the west gallery.

**Teth**  
The embassy.
Warm, mineral-smelling air passed over the guests and carried traces of their breath into the walls. Outside, sirens began in three descending notes.
Illuminara listened past the stone, running feet and arriving engines to the slower pattern inside the structure. It was an organism assembling the conditions in which it could become conscious.
*The city thinks the danger is a building. Teth thinks the danger is loneliness.*

**Illuminara**  
My aim is simple to say and difficult to earn: every guest out, the child alive, the neighborhood standing. Tell us what happens at eighteen hundred.

**Teth**  
The shell takes its first direction. On Vael, an egg opens into empty sky. Here, your towers stand where sky should be.

**Jo**  
How large?

**Teth**  
Three hundred and forty metres from wing root to wing root, if she is healthy.

**Jo**  
Then becoming herself removes three blocks.
A third contraction sealed the shutters. Guests rushed the east wall. It yielded like cartilage and pushed them gently, inexorably, back.

Illuminara put her palm against it. Pressure layered beneath the surface: gas chambers, folded bone, vascular cables full of silver fluid. She could hold a rupture. She could not make a living birth harmless by deciding harder than everyone else.

**Illuminara**  
Why were we not told?

**Teth**  
Because your council would have emptied the embassy last month. The child requires an assembled community at hatching—breath, memory, mutual recognition. An empty shell produces a body that never wakes.
Mara came to the dais with the boy holding her sleeve.

**Mara**  
And a full shell kills the people in it when the pressure changes.

**Teth**  
Yes.
The plainness of the answer was worse than denial.

**Illuminara**  
Then no one here is a component. Not your child, not your guests, not the residents outside. We learn what she actually needs before anyone is asked to trust a timetable you concealed.
Teth bowed her head, not in agreement but in acknowledgment of a charge she could not evade.

**Teth**  
You have four hours and forty-six minutes. I will not consent to an evacuation that kills her.

**Illuminara**  
And I will not call captivity a welcome.
The building breathed again. This time the guests' heartbeats echoed faintly inside it, as if the unborn child were trying to count who had stayed.

scenes.title: What the Child Hears
paragraphs: *Inner treaty archive · 13:51, four hours and nine minutes to hatching*
The archive had become a nursery without ceasing to be an archive. Treaty tablets floated in amber fluid. Between them, translucent organs opened like ears.
Jo exposed a diplomatic air monitor. Mara arranged twelve volunteers in a circle, six human and six Vaeli, each breathing through a clean sampling hood. No one had been ordered to participate.
Teth watched from the threshold with both hands around a black ceremonial key.

**Jo**  
The wall draws carbon dioxide, heat pulses and volatile compounds. It brightens when people recognize one another.
Mara asked the volunteers to recite names. The organ brightened for someone present and remained gray for lists of strangers.
A Vaeli elder named Suil clicked three plates along his wrist. The others replied with the same uneven rhythm. The organ unfurled another centimeter.
Illuminara watched the pauses rather than the sound. Each answer arrived slightly late, corrected itself and changed the breathing of the person who heard it.

**Illuminara**  
Play that exact exchange back. Put no listener behind the wall.
Jo sent the recording through the archive speakers. Nothing happened.

**Illuminara**  
Now place one speaker outside. Let someone inside begin a sentence only that person can finish.
Mara brought the boy to the wall. His name was Eren; his mother waited beyond the west barrier. He began a nursery riddle. Her voice answered over an emergency radio, late and breathless.
The organ opened so quickly that amber fluid shivered in every treaty vessel.
Eren cried and kept answering her. The unborn child altered a valve toward their imperfect exchange.

**Illuminara**  
There is the difference. A recording repeats a pattern. A relationship risks an answer. She is not feeding on bodies; she is learning reciprocal presence.

**Teth**  
Those are your words for the same duty.

**Illuminara**  
No. Attention can travel. A body behind a sealed door cannot choose whether to carry it.
Teth stepped into the circle.

**Teth**  
On Vael, forty households enter the shell. They speak the names of the dead and the promises of the living. No child has awakened without that enclosure.

**Mara**  
No Vaeli child has awakened in a city that did not consent to become part of the shell.
Suil made the wrist rhythm again, slower.

**Suil**  
Ambassador, my daughter is outside the east cordon. Her name belongs in the welcome. You excluded her because she was not invited to the reception.
Teth's key shifted in her hands.

**Teth**  
The rite uses those assembled when labor begins. On Vael, the registry seal makes their witness count; off-world, only the old emergency attestation can.

**Suil**  
The rite never had a cordon.
That sentence separated tradition from the geometry in which tradition had first been practiced.
Commander Vey's face appeared in living amber.

**Vey**  
Artillery can breach the upper shell before sixteen hundred. After that, firing becomes less controllable. Open the doors or I fire.

**Teth**  
A breach before she fixes her pressure tears the primary vessel. You kill her and half the guests.

**Vey**  
If I wait, three blocks fall. I am not trading fifty thousand residents for one concealed birth.

**Illuminara**  
Give us until fifteen thirty for a demonstrated exit carrying a live response. Prepare your batteries. Do not mistake preparation for proof that destruction is the only boundary.
Vey looked to Jo.

**Jo**  
At fifteen thirty I show you a stable pressure passage and an external response, or I tell you we failed.
The artillery clock stopped moving for the moment.

**Illuminara**  
We test a ring outside. Guests answer one another in real time. Residents may join or decline. If she follows the relationships through the wall, the community becomes larger because no one is trapped into representing it.

**Teth**  
Build your ring. I have not agreed to turn the key.

scenes.title: A Welcome That Can Move
paragraphs: *West service court and adjoining avenue · 15:04, two hours and fifty-six minutes to hatching*
The first pressure passage was not a miracle. It was an argument made from ducts, membranes and people who knew where the building had lied to its own blueprints.

Jo's crews opened an old freight throat between the kitchens and the west court. Illuminara held soft tissue apart while Vaeli attendants mapped vessels that could not be cut. Every thirty seconds she let the membrane bear its own load.
It failed twice.
The first failure broke Jo's thumb. The second knocked sixty people down; medics treated two concussions and a dislocated shoulder. Teth demanded the work stop.

**Teth**  
You are teaching the shell to reject the wound.
Jo cradled his splinted hand.

**Jo**  
Then we stop treating it as a wound. The kitchen throat moves food across a pressure boundary. We widen its rhythm.
Illuminara matched the contractions only long enough for the crews to set flexible rings. The third passage opened like a valve and stayed open for seven breaths.

Mara crossed first with a red scarf Eren's mother could recognize. Her ears bled when she reached the court. She stood and answered Eren through a resonator Jo had built from tram rails and emergency speakers.
Inside, the nursery organs brightened.

One by one, then in groups of twelve, guests entered the throat. Each chose a person to answer from the other side. Names, jokes, promises and complaints passed through the ring. The structure steadied rather than weakening.
A Vaeli mourner named Kher planted herself beside a darkened organ containing the chemical trace of her dead partner.

**Kher**  
His last breath entered this shell. If I leave, the child loses the only ancestor I brought.
Teth moved to invoke her office. Illuminara stopped the order, not Kher.

**Illuminara**  
What would carrying him mean to you, not to the protocol?
Kher touched her brow to the wall.

**Kher**  
That she hears the pause he always left before saying yes. Recordings remove it.
Outside, Suil answered with the first half of a question in the dead partner’s language, then waited through the long, peculiar pause.
Kher completed the answer. The organ released a bead of amber fluid into her palm and went dark.

**Kher**  
Now I can go.
The child had not transferred a soul. She had recognized a living pattern and let the mourner carry its sign. Illuminara did not explain that while Kher was weeping.

At fifteen twenty-seven, three hundred and eighteen guests were outside. Fewer than a quarter of nearby residents joined the ring. Others packed medicines, shut gas lines and moved relatives. Refusal did not weaken the signal; the ring grew more coherent when participation was explicit.
Vey arrived with the artillery code. Jo showed him the stable passage and the live nursery response.

**Jo**  
Presence crosses the shell. That does not prove we can turn three hundred metres of wing away from the towers.

**Vey**  
Then you have evacuated a building that will still demolish the avenue.

**Mara**  
We proved Teth’s first fear wrong without proving yours wrong. Now we have one problem to engineer instead of two groups threatening each other’s dead.

**Vey**  
Seventeen hundred. If there is no verified opening path, I fire while direction still matters.
Teth came to the passage but did not enter it. She still held the key.

**Teth**  
The key fixes first opening. On Vael, wind and gravity choose with us. Here, every direction has a wall.
Jo projected the city model. North held the hospital towers, east the river cranes, south the oldest homes. West, beyond a low freight district, lay the abandoned Grayglass quarry.
Illuminara felt the folded wings testing tiny pressure differences. The child did not know west. She knew warmth, resonance, open volume and the pulse of an answering community.

**Illuminara**  
We do not give her an order. We build a sky she can recognize.

**Teth**  
You would lure a newborn like cargo.

**Illuminara**  
We offer one survivable direction and leave the key in your hand.

**Teth**  
You still ask me to save the witnesses by removing the witnessing that lets her live.

**Illuminara**  
They are witnessing now. If you require confinement after she has answered them through a wall, the enclosure serves the rite, not the child.
Teth did not yield.

**Teth**  
Build the sky. I will decide whether it contains a welcome or merely an escape route.

scenes.title: The Open Side
paragraphs: *Orison western freight corridor · 17:12, forty-eight minutes to hatching*

Freight cranes raised acoustic sails. Tram substations heated a rising corridor toward Grayglass. Fire crews flooded two empty lots so their cooling surfaces bent the thermal gradient away from the apartments.
The city did not clear a perfect path. It made one direction less lethal than the others.
Inside, one hundred and seven guests remained, some too injured to cross quickly. Mara moved stretchers through the living valve while Jo watched its pressure margin narrow.
At seventeen twenty-six, the embassy grew a new vertebra through the west wall. It entered a neighboring archive and stopped one metre inside the reading room.
Vey raised the artillery code.

**Vey**  
The growth crossed the property line.

**Jo**  
Give us eight minutes. Late fire is worse now; only the wing’s direction can make it tolerable.
Illuminara braced the vertebra while archivists cleared the room and crews removed the facade around it. The child felt resistance without injury and curled the growth toward the warmer westward air.
The effort gathered light at the edges of Illuminara’s vision. She let Teth see it.

**Teth**  
You could hold the whole body.

**Illuminara**  
For minutes. When I released it, her first world would be an invisible hand she could never meet. I can keep people alive while we understand. I cannot live her first choice for her.

Through the passage, hundreds of guests and residents stood in widening circles. They did not chant in unison. They exchanged promised names and present facts: I am here. The west is open. The east is not yours. We will meet you at Grayglass.
Eren's mother held the red scarf. Kher placed her dead partner's long pause into every third response. The pattern traveled imperfectly and alive.
The child turned another valve west.
Mara pushed the final stretcher through. Twenty-three people remained by choice, including Teth.

**Mara**  
Everyone who cannot choose is out. Everyone left can walk. That includes you.
The other twenty-two crossed behind the stretcher, carrying only what their hands had chosen. Teth waited until the last heel cleared the passage, then stood alone beside the key.

**Teth**  
If I turn the key beyond the shell, Vaeli law may not recognize the hatching. She may be born without a homeworld.
Mara’s anger became very still.

**Mara**  
You hid the clock because you feared our law. Do not keep people inside because you fear yours.
Illuminara looked through the passage at Suil and Kher.

**Illuminara**  
Teth said the rite uses those assembled when labor begins. Who decides whether this ring is assembled?
Suil struck the old wrist rhythm. Vaeli voices answered from every part of the ring.

**Suil**  
Labor began when the inner light turned blue. We were assembled then. The shell did not make the assembly; our answers did.
Kher lifted the bead the nursery had given her.

**Kher**  
I carried an ancestor across the wall and the child answered him here. I witness this as a hatching ground.

**Teth**  
You have no registry seal.

**Suil**  
The first law is older than the registry. Two elders, one mourner and the guardian may attest when no home sky survives. You taught me that clause before our first voyage.
Teth stared at him, then at the living organs bright with signals from the street.

**Suil**  
Bring the key where the rite already is. Vael will have to answer our testimony. It cannot honestly say the child was alone.
The passage was still open. No alarm had sounded. Teth walked to it, stopped once beside Mara, and stepped through with the key while there was time to turn back.
Outside, she faced Vey beneath the western sail.

**Vey**  
If the first wing turns south, I fire.

**Teth**  
If you fire before it turns, you kill her.

**Vey**  
Yes.
Neither softened the truth for the other.
Teth placed the key into Jo’s street resonator. It rejected the interface, which lacked the chemical warmth of the shell.
Jo opened the casing with his good hand. Mara wrapped the key in Kher’s amber bead. Living fluid closed the circuit.

**Teth**  
This is not how the rite is done.

**Kher**  
No. It is how this child is being born.
Teth turned the key west.

The embassy split from roof to foundation with the patience of a seed opening stone. Illuminara held the pressure front above the ring while Jo’s sails translated live replies into the westward gradient.
A pale wing rose, found the warm corridor and folded toward it. The second followed. Their tips passed fourteen metres above the nearest apartments.
The newborn pulled free, answering nine hundred breathing patterns with one uneven pulse of her own. Vey removed his hand from the firing code.
She followed the offered sky toward Grayglass. Behind her, twelve years of chambers and ceremonial stone collapsed inward into a mound no higher than the trees.

scenes.title: A Route Back
paragraphs: *Grayglass quarry overlook · 20:36, two hours and thirty-six minutes after hatching*
The newborn circled three times, tested the quarry wall with a low pressure note and landed only after Teth transmitted the mineral map without command codes.
Engineers ran water to a temporary basin. Former embassy guests built wind screens from the acoustic sails. Neighborhood crews counted forty-one broken windows instead of three flattened blocks.
No one called the outcome costless.
Teth stood before a public recorder without her ambassadorial chain. She acknowledged concealment of the timetable, unlawful confinement and breach of the founding disclosure promise.

**Teth**  
I believed she could have a community only if I prevented that community from leaving. I was wrong about the child. I was not wrong that she needed an answer.
Mara sat beside Eren and his mother.

**Mara**  
Those can both be true. So can this: you saved her when you carried the key out, and you endangered us when you hid the clock.
Teth did not ask one truth to erase the other.

Jo set four habitat terms: Vael paid the emergency costs, Orison engineers could stop unsafe work, no one could remotely control the newborn, and a public return corridor joined the quarry to the old embassy square for visits chosen by both city and child.
Suil and Kher placed their hands beside Teth’s on the recorder. A Vaeli recognition glyph appeared: provisional, lawful and reviewable—the first answer from the homeworld, not the last.
Vey acknowledged how close he had come and surrendered the artillery code for inquiry.

**Teth**  
Would you have fired?

**Vey**  
If the wing turned south.

**Teth**  
I believe you.
It was not friendship. It was enough truth to begin the next negotiation.
The newborn raised her head at the live voices. Her pressure note crossed the basin and returned from the rock with Kher’s long pause inside it.
Kher laughed once, then covered her face.

**Teth**  
She remembers the shape of the welcome.

**Illuminara**  
She remembers that it answered.
Eren stepped to the safety line and called his name. A pulse lifted ripples against his shoes without crossing the mark.
He called his mother’s name. The answer came back different.
The newborn was not repeating a recording. She was learning that a name could point outward and receive an answer.
She opened one wing toward Orison and left it there until the last person on the overlook had chosen whether to answer.

critic_line: Illuminara discovers that the unborn child needs freely answered presence rather than captive bodies, then protects a moving welcome without choosing for Teth or the newborn; all nine hundred guests leave, the city survives, Vaeli witnesses carry the rite outside and the child gains a lawful habitat with a route back.

translation_sl.title: VELEPOSLANIŠTVO, KI SE JE IZVALILO
translation_sl.deck: Orisonovo nezemeljsko veleposlaništvo je jajce, pet ur pred izvalitvijo, v njem pa je zaprtih devetsto gostov in na poti njegovega prvega premika stojijo trije mestni bloki. Illuminara mora veleposlanici Teth pomagati zaščititi otroka, ne da bi nehotene sosede spremenila v del poroda — in odkriti, ali se zakonita dobrodošlica lahko premakne onkraj svojih zidov.
translation_sl.shape: Pet prizorov vodi od diplomatskega sprejema, ki ga prekine prvi krč stavbe, prek poskusa v živo, ki dokaže, da nerojeni otrok potrebuje vzajemno pozornost, ne ujetih teles, do prostovoljne evakuacije in odprtega koridorja, ki ga zgradi mesto. Vaelske priče odgovorijo na Tethin strah, da bo izvalitev zunaj pravno brez domovine, preden ključ svobodno odnese ven. Veleposlaništvo je izgubljeno, toda vseh devetsto gostov odide, trije bloki ostanejo pokonci, novorojenka izbere kamnolomski habitat, povezan z Orisonom z javno povratno potjo, Teth pa sprejme preiskavo, ne da bi izgubila svoje mesto varuhinje.

scenes.title: Stavba začne dihati
paragraphs: *Veleposlaništvo Drugega neba, Orison · 13.07, štiri ure in triinpetdeset minut do izvalitve*
Veleposlaništvo je vdihnilo, ko se je veleposlanica Teth mestu zahvaljevala za dvanajst let miru.

Devetsto kozarcev je zazvenelo ob devetsto krožnikih. Tla so se pod njimi dvignila, ne kakor ob potresu, temveč kakor prsnica živali, ki zajema sapo. Lestenci so zložili svoje steklene liste. Vsa zunanja vrata so čezse potegnila bel šiv in postala zid.
Mara Venn je ujela dečka, preden je udaril ob banketno mizo. Na drugem koncu dvorane je glavni inženir Jo Rian pokleknil na eno koleno in pritisnil dva prsta ob tla.

**Jo**  
To ni posedanje. Ima utrip.
Drugi krč je stekel skozi stebre. Njihove diplomatske rezbarije so se zmehčale v rebra.
Teth je stala na odru. Prosojne opne vzdolž njenega grla so se enkrat odprle, vijolične od strahu, nato pa zaprle za obrednim mirom.

**Teth**  
Gostje Orisona in Vaela, ostanite, kjer ste. Hiša začenja zakonito preobrazbo. Panika bo poškodovala otroka.
Vsak stenski zaslon se je spremenil v isto občinsko opozorilo: PREDVIDENA STRUKTURNA RAZŠIRITEV. EVAKUIRAJTE BLOKE OD SEDEMNAJST DO DEVETNAJST. DOVOLJENJE ZA TOPNIŠTVO V ČAKANJU.

Mara je vodila dihalno kliniko dve ulici vzhodno. Poznala je vse, kar se je skrivalo v besedi evakuirajte: postelje brez dvigal, koncentratorje kisika brez vtičnic, kuhinje, zapuščene z vročimi gorilniki.

**Mara**  
Kateri otrok?
Tethin pogled je našel Illuminara pri zahodni galeriji.

**Teth**  
Veleposlaništvo.
Topel zrak z vonjem po mineralih je oplazil goste in odnesel sledi njihovega diha v zidove. Zunaj so se sirene oglasile v treh padajočih tonih.
Illuminara je poslušala mimo kamna, tekaških korakov in prihajajočih vozil do počasnejšega vzorca v zgradbi. To je bil organizem, ki je sestavljal pogoje, v katerih bi se lahko ovedel.
*Mesto misli, da je nevarnost stavba. Teth misli, da je nevarnost osamljenost.*

**Illuminara**  
Moj cilj je lahko izreči in težko doseči: vsi gostje ven, otrok živ, soseska pokonci. Povejte nam, kaj se zgodi ob osemnajstih.

**Teth**  
Lupina izbere svojo prvo smer. Na Vaelu se jajce odpre v prazno nebo. Tukaj vaši stolpi stojijo tam, kjer bi moralo biti nebo.

**Jo**  
Kako velika?

**Teth**  
Tristo štirideset metrov od korena do korena kril, če je zdrava.

**Jo**  
Potem bo s tem, ko postane to, kar je, odstranila tri bloke.
Tretji krč je zapečatil polkna. Gostje so planili proti vzhodnemu zidu. Ta je popustil kakor hrustanec in jih nežno, neustavljivo potisnil nazaj.

Illuminara je nanj položila dlan. Pod površino so bile naložene plasti pritiska: plinske komore, zložene kosti, žilni kabli, polni srebrne tekočine. Lahko je zadržala razpoko. Živega rojstva ni mogla narediti neškodljivega tako, da bi odločala odločneje od vseh drugih.

**Illuminara**  
Zakaj nam niste povedali?

**Teth**  
Ker bi vaš svet prejšnji mesec izpraznil veleposlaništvo. Otrok ob izvalitvi potrebuje zbrano skupnost — dih, spomin, vzajemno prepoznavanje. Prazna lupina ustvari telo, ki se nikoli ne prebudi.
Mara je prišla do odra, deček pa se je držal za njen rokav.

**Mara**  
Polna lupina pa ubije ljudi v njej, ko se pritisk spremeni.

**Teth**  
Da.
Neposrednost odgovora je bila hujša od zanikanja.

**Illuminara**  
Potem nihče tukaj ni sestavni del. Ne vaš otrok, ne vaši gostje, ne prebivalci zunaj. Ugotovimo, kaj dejansko potrebuje, preden se od kogar koli zahteva, naj zaupa časovnici, ki ste jo prikrili.
Teth je sklonila glavo, ne v soglasju, temveč v priznanju obtožbe, ki se ji ni mogla izogniti.

**Teth**  
Imate štiri ure in šestinštirideset minut. Ne bom privolila v evakuacijo, ki jo ubije.

**Illuminara**  
Jaz pa ujetništva ne bom imenovala dobrodošlica.
Stavba je spet zadihala. Tokrat so v njej rahlo odmevali srčni utripi gostov, kakor da bi nerojeni otrok poskušal prešteti, kdo je ostal.

scenes.title: Kar otrok sliši
paragraphs: *Notranji pogodbeni arhiv · 13.51, štiri ure in devet minut do izvalitve*
Arhiv je postal otroška soba, ne da bi prenehal biti arhiv. Pogodbene plošče so lebdele v jantarni tekočini. Med njimi so se kakor ušesa odpirali prosojni organi.

Jo je razkril diplomatski merilnik zraka. Mara je dvanajst prostovoljcev razporedila v krog, šest ljudi in šest Vaelcev, vsak je dihal skozi čisto vzorčevalno kapuco. Nikomur ni bilo ukazano sodelovati.
Teth je opazovala s praga, z obema rokama okrog črnega obrednega ključa.

**Jo**  
Zid črpa ogljikov dioksid, toplotne sunke in hlapne spojine. Zasveti, ko se ljudje med seboj prepoznajo.
Mara je prostovoljce prosila, naj recitirajo imena. Organ je zasvetil za navzočo osebo, pri seznamih neznancev pa je ostal siv.
Vaelski starešina Suil je udaril po treh ploščicah vzdolž zapestja. Drugi so odgovorili z istim neenakomernim ritmom. Organ se je razprl še za centimeter.
Illuminara je opazovala premore, ne zvoka. Vsak odgovor je prišel malo prepozno, se popravil in spremenil dihanje osebe, ki ga je slišala.

**Illuminara**  
Predvajajte to izmenjavo natanko tako. Za zidom naj ne bo poslušalca.
Jo je posnetek predvajal skozi arhivske zvočnike. Nič se ni zgodilo.

**Illuminara**  
Zdaj postavite en zvočnik zunaj. Naj nekdo znotraj začne stavek, ki ga lahko dokonča samo ta oseba.
Mara je pripeljala dečka k zidu. Ime mu je bilo Eren; njegova mati je čakala onkraj zahodne pregrade. Začel je otroško uganko. Njen glas mu je odgovoril po nujnem radiu, prepozen in zadihan.
Organ se je odprl tako hitro, da je jantarna tekočina vzdrhtela v vseh pogodbenih posodah.
Eren je jokal in ji še naprej odgovarjal. Nerojeni otrok je preusmeril zaklopko proti njuni nepopolni izmenjavi.

**Illuminara**  
V tem je razlika. Posnetek ponavlja vzorec. Odnos tvega odgovor. Ne hrani se s telesi; uči se vzajemne navzočnosti.

**Teth**  
To so vaše besede za isto dolžnost.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Pozornost lahko potuje. Telo za zaprtimi vrati ne more izbrati, ali jo bo nosilo.
Teth je stopila v krog.

**Teth**  
Na Vaelu v lupino vstopi štirideset gospodinjstev. Izgovarjajo imena mrtvih in obljube živih. Noben otrok se še ni prebudil brez tega oklepa.

**Mara**  
Noben vaelski otrok se ni prebudil v mestu, ki ni privolilo, da postane del lupine.
Suil je znova izvedel zapestni ritem, počasneje.

**Suil**  
Veleposlanica, moja hči je zunaj vzhodnega kordona. Njeno ime sodi v dobrodošlico. Izključili ste jo, ker ni bila povabljena na sprejem.
Tethin ključ se je premaknil v njenih rokah.

**Teth**  
Obred uporablja tiste, ki so zbrani, ko se začne porod. Na Vaelu registrski pečat določi, da njihovo pričevanje šteje; zunaj domačega sveta velja le stara izredna potrditev.

**Suil**  
Obred nikoli ni imel kordona.
Ta stavek je ločil tradicijo od geometrije, v kateri je bila tradicija prvič izvajana.
Obraz poveljnika Veya se je prikazal v živem jantarju.

**Vey**  
Topništvo lahko prebije zgornjo lupino pred šestnajsto uro. Po tem streljanje postane manj nadzorljivo. Odprite vrata ali pa bom streljal.

**Teth**  
Preboj, preden utrdi svoj pritisk, raztrga glavno žilo. Ubili boste njo in polovico gostov.

**Vey**  
Če čakam, padejo trije bloki. Ne bom zamenjal petdeset tisoč prebivalcev za eno prikrito rojstvo.

**Illuminara**  
Dajte nam čas do petnajste trideset za dokazan izhod, ki bo prenesel živ odziv. Pripravite baterije. Priprave ne zamenjajte za dokaz, da je uničenje edina meja.
Vey je pogledal Joa.

**Jo**  
Ob petnajsti trideset vam pokažem stabilen tlačni prehod in zunanji odziv ali pa vam povem, da nam ni uspelo.
Topniška ura se je za zdaj ustavila.

**Illuminara**  
Zunaj preizkusimo krog. Gostje si odgovarjajo v realnem času. Prebivalci se lahko pridružijo ali odklonijo. Če sledi odnosom skozi zid, bo skupnost postala večja, ker nihče ni ujet vanjo kot njen predstavnik.

**Teth**  
Zgradite svoj krog. Nisem še privolila, da obrnem ključ.

scenes.title: Dobrodošlica, ki se lahko premakne
paragraphs: *Zahodno servisno dvorišče in sosednja avenija · 15.04, dve uri in šestinpetdeset minut do izvalitve*
Prvi tlačni prehod ni bil čudež. Bil je argument, sestavljen iz vodov, opn in ljudi, ki so vedeli, kje je stavba lagala o svojih načrtih.

Jojeve ekipe so odprle staro tovorno grlo med kuhinjami in zahodnim dvoriščem. Illuminara je držala mehko tkivo narazen, medtem ko so vaelski spremljevalci označevali žile, ki jih ni bilo mogoče prerezati. Vsakih trideset sekund je opni dovolila, da je nosila lastno breme.
Dvakrat je spodletelo.
Pri prvi napaki si je Jo zlomil palec. Druga je podrla šestdeset ljudi; reševalci so oskrbeli dva pretresa možganov in izpahnjeno ramo. Teth je zahtevala, naj delo ustavijo.

**Teth**  
Lupino učite, da zavrne rano.
Jo je pestoval roko z opornico.

**Jo**  
Potem jo nehamo obravnavati kot rano. Kuhinjsko grlo prenaša hrano čez tlačno mejo. Razširili bomo njegov ritem.
Illuminara se je uskladila s krči le toliko časa, da so ekipe namestile prožne obroče. Tretji prehod se je odprl kakor zaklopka in ostal odprt sedem vdihov.

Mara je šla prva z rdečim šalom, ki ga je Erenova mati lahko prepoznala. Ko je prišla na dvorišče, so ji krvavela ušesa. Vstala je in Erenu odgovorila skozi resonator, ki ga je Jo zgradil iz tramvajskih tirnic in zvočnikov za nujne primere.
V notranjosti so organi otroške sobe zasvetili.

Drug za drugim, nato v skupinah po dvanajst, so gostje vstopali v grlo. Vsak je izbral osebo, ki mu bo odgovorila z druge strani. Imena, šale, obljube in pritožbe so šle skozi obroč. Zgradba se je ustalila, namesto da bi oslabela.
Vaelska žalujoča Kher se je postavila ob zatemnjen organ, ki je vseboval kemično sled njenega umrlega partnerja.

**Kher**  
Njegov zadnji dih je vstopil v to lupino. Če odidem, otrok izgubi edinega prednika, ki sem ga prinesla.
Teth je hotela uporabiti svojo funkcijo. Illuminara je ustavila ukaz, ne Kher.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj bi vam pomenilo, da ga odnesete s seboj, ne kaj bi to pomenilo protokolu?
Kher se je s čelom dotaknila zidu.

**Kher**  
Da sliši premor, ki ga je vedno naredil, preden je rekel da. Posnetki ga odstranijo.
Zunaj je Suil odgovoril s prvo polovico vprašanja v jeziku pokojnega partnerja, nato pa počakal skozi dolg, poseben premor.
Kher je dokončala odgovor. Organ je v njeno dlan izpustil kapljico jantarne tekočine in ugasnil.

**Kher**  
Zdaj lahko grem.
Otrok ni prenesel duše. Prepoznal je živ vzorec in žalujoči dovolil odnesti njegov znak. Illuminara tega ni razlagala, medtem ko je Kher jokala.

Ob petnajsti sedemindvajset je bilo zunaj tristo osemnajst gostov. Krogu se je pridružila manj kot četrtina bližnjih prebivalcev. Drugi so pakirali zdravila, zapirali plinske vode in selili sorodnike. Zavrnitev ni oslabila signala; krog je postal bolj skladen, ko je bilo sodelovanje izrecno.
Vey je prispel s topniško kodo. Jo mu je pokazal stabilen prehod in odziv otroške sobe v živo.

**Jo**  
Navzočnost prečka lupino. To ne dokazuje, da lahko tristo metrov kril obrnemo stran od stolpov.

**Vey**  
Potem ste evakuirali stavbo, ki bo avenijo še vedno porušila.

**Mara**  
Tethin prvi strah smo ovrgli, ne da bi ovrgli vašega. Zdaj imamo en problem, ki ga moramo rešiti z inženirstvom, namesto dveh skupin, ki si grozita z mrtvimi.

**Vey**  
Sedemnajsta ura. Če ne bo preverjene poti odpiranja, bom streljal, dokler je smer še pomembna.
Teth je prišla do prehoda, vendar ni vstopila vanj. Še vedno je držala ključ.

**Teth**  
Ključ določi prvo odpiranje. Na Vaelu z nami izbirata veter in težnost. Tukaj ima vsaka smer zid.

Jo je projiciral model mesta. Na severu so bili bolnišnični stolpi, na vzhodu rečna dvigala, na jugu najstarejši domovi. Na zahodu, onkraj nizkega tovornega okrožja, je ležal opuščeni kamnolom Grayglass.
Illuminara je čutila, kako zložena krila preizkušajo drobne razlike v pritisku. Otrok ni poznal zahoda. Poznal je toploto, resonanco, odprto prostornino in utrip odzivne skupnosti.

**Illuminara**  
Ne damo ji ukaza. Zgradimo nebo, ki ga lahko prepozna.

**Teth**  
Novorojenko bi zvabili kakor tovor.

**Illuminara**  
Ponudimo eno smer, v kateri lahko preživi, ključ pa pustimo v vaših rokah.

**Teth**  
Še vedno me prosite, naj priče rešim tako, da odstranim pričevanje, ki ji omogoča življenje.

**Illuminara**  
Pričujejo zdaj. Če zahtevate zaprtost, potem ko jim je odgovorila skozi zid, oklep služi obredu, ne otroku.
Teth ni popustila.

**Teth**  
Zgradite nebo. Odločila bom, ali vsebuje dobrodošlico ali zgolj pot za pobeg.

scenes.title: Odprta stran
paragraphs: *Orisonov zahodni tovorni koridor · 17.12, oseminštirideset minut do izvalitve*

Tovorna dvigala so dvignila zvočna jadra. Tramvajske podpostaje so ogrele vzpenjajoč se koridor proti Grayglassu. Gasilske ekipe so poplavile dve prazni zemljišči, da bi njune hladilne površine ukrivile toplotni gradient stran od stanovanj.
Mesto ni očistilo popolne poti. Eno smer je naredilo manj smrtonosno od drugih.
Znotraj je ostalo sto sedem gostov, nekateri preveč poškodovani, da bi hitro prečkali. Mara je potiskala nosila skozi živo zaklopko, medtem ko je Jo opazoval, kako se njena tlačna rezerva oži.
Ob sedemnajsti šestindvajset je veleposlaništvu skozi zahodni zid zraslo novo vretence. Vstopilo je v sosednji arhiv in se ustavilo en meter znotraj čitalnice.
Vey je dvignil topniško kodo.

**Vey**  
Izrastek je prestopil mejo zemljišča.

**Jo**  
Dajte nam osem minut. Pozno streljanje je zdaj hujše; znosno ga lahko naredi le smer krila.

Illuminara je podprla vretence, medtem ko so arhivarji izpraznili prostor, ekipe pa okoli njega odstranile fasado. Otrok je občutil odpor brez poškodbe in izrastek ukrivil proti toplejšemu zahodnemu zraku.
Napor je nabiral svetlobo na robovih Illuminarainega vida. Pustila je, da je Teth to videla.

**Teth**  
Lahko bi zadržali celotno telo.

**Illuminara**  
Za nekaj minut. Ko bi ga izpustila, bi bil njen prvi svet nevidna roka, ki je nikoli ne bi mogla srečati. Ljudi lahko ohranim pri življenju, medtem ko razumemo. Njene prve odločitve ne morem živeti namesto nje.

Skozi prehod je na stotine gostov in prebivalcev stalo v vse širših krogih. Niso enoglasno recitirali. Izmenjevali so obljubljena imena in sedanja dejstva: Tukaj sem. Zahod je odprt. Vzhod ni tvoj. Srečali te bomo pri Grayglassu.
Erenova mati je držala rdeči šal. Kher je dolgi premor svojega pokojnega partnerja vnesla v vsak tretji odziv. Vzorec je potoval nepopolno in živ.
Otrok je še eno zaklopko obrnil proti zahodu.
Mara je skozi potisnila zadnja nosila. Triindvajset ljudi je ostalo po lastni izbiri, med njimi Teth.

**Mara**  
Vsi, ki niso mogli izbirati, so zunaj. Vsi, ki so ostali, lahko hodijo. To vključuje vas.
Drugih dvaindvajset je prečkalo za nosili in nosilo le tisto, kar so izbrale njihove roke. Teth je počakala, da je zadnja peta zapustila prehod, nato pa sama obstala ob ključu.

**Teth**  
Če ključ obrnem zunaj lupine, vaelsko pravo morda ne bo priznalo izvalitve. Lahko se rodi brez domačega sveta.
Marina jeza je postala zelo mirna.

**Mara**  
Uro ste prikrili, ker ste se bali našega prava. Ne zadržujte ljudi znotraj, ker se bojite svojega.
Illuminara je skozi prehod pogledala Suila in Kher.

**Illuminara**  
Teth je rekla, da obred uporablja tiste, ki so zbrani, ko se začne porod. Kdo odloča, ali je ta krog zbran?
Suil je udaril stari zapestni ritem. Vaelski glasovi so odgovorili iz vseh delov kroga.

**Suil**  
Porod se je začel, ko je notranja svetloba postala modra. Takrat smo bili zbrani. Ni nas zbrala lupina; zbrali so nas naši odgovori.
Kher je dvignila kapljico, ki ji jo je dala otroška soba.

**Kher**  
Prednika sem prenesla skozi zid in otrok mu je tukaj odgovoril. Pričujem, da je to kraj izvalitve.

**Teth**  
Nimate registrskega pečata.

**Suil**  
Prvi zakon je starejši od registra. Dva starešina, ena žalujoča in varuhinja lahko potrdijo, kadar nobeno domače nebo ne preživi. Ta člen ste me naučili pred našim prvim potovanjem.
Teth je strmela vanj, nato v žive organe, svetle od signalov z ulice.

**Suil**  
Prinesite ključ tja, kjer obred že je. Vael bo moral odgovoriti na naše pričevanje. Ne more pošteno reči, da je bil otrok sam.
Prehod je bil še vedno odprt. Noben alarm se ni oglasil. Teth je stopila do njega, se enkrat ustavila ob Mari in stopila skozi s ključem, dokler je še imela čas, da se vrne.
Zunaj se je soočila z Veyem pod zahodnim jadrom.

**Vey**  
Če se prvo krilo obrne proti jugu, bom streljal.

**Teth**  
Če streljate, preden se obrne, jo boste ubili.

**Vey**  
Da.
Nobeden ni olepšal resnice za drugega.
Teth je ključ vstavila v Jojev ulični resonator. Ta je vmesnik zavrnil, ker ni imel kemične toplote lupine.
Jo je z zdravo roko odprl ohišje. Mara je ključ ovila v Kherino jantarno kapljico. Živa tekočina je sklenila vezje.

**Teth**  
Obred se ne izvaja tako.

**Kher**  
Ne. Tako se rojeva ta otrok.
Teth je ključ obrnila proti zahodu.

Veleposlaništvo se je od strehe do temeljev razprlo s potrpežljivostjo semena, ki odpira kamen. Illuminara je držala tlačno fronto nad krogom, Jojeva jadra pa so odzive v živo prevajala v zahodni gradient.
Bledo krilo se je dvignilo, našlo topli koridor in se zložilo proti njemu. Drugo mu je sledilo. Njuni konici sta šli štirinajst metrov nad najbližjimi stanovanji.
Novorojenka se je izvlekla in na devetsto vzorcev dihanja odgovorila z enim neenakomernim lastnim utripom. Vey je umaknil roko s strelne kode.
Sledila je ponujenemu nebu proti Grayglassu. Za njo se je dvanajst let soban in obrednega kamna sesedlo navznoter v gomilo, ki ni bila višja od dreves.

scenes.title: Pot nazaj
paragraphs: *Razgledišče nad kamnolomom Grayglass · 20.36, dve uri in šestintrideset minut po izvalitvi*
Novorojenka je trikrat zakrožila, z nizkim tlačnim tonom preizkusila steno kamnoloma in pristala šele, ko ji je Teth poslala zemljevid mineralov brez ukaznih kod.

Inženirji so speljali vodo v začasni bazen. Nekdanji gostje veleposlaništva so iz zvočnih jader postavili vetrobrane. Soseske ekipe so preštele enainštirideset razbitih oken namesto treh sploščenih blokov.
Nihče izida ni imenoval brezplačnega.
Teth je brez veleposlaniške verige stopila pred javni zapisovalnik. Priznala je prikrivanje časovnice, nezakonito pridržanje in kršitev ustanovne obljube o razkritju.

**Teth**  
Verjela sem, da ima lahko skupnost le, če ji preprečim, da odide. Glede otroka sem se motila. Nisem pa se motila, da potrebuje odgovor.
Mara je sedela ob Erenu in njegovi materi.

**Mara**  
Oboje je lahko res. Prav tako to: rešili ste jo, ko ste ključ odnesli ven, nas pa ogrozili, ko ste prikrili uro.
Teth ni zahtevala, da ena resnica izbriše drugo.

Jo je določil štiri pogoje habitata: Vael je plačal nujne stroške, orisonski inženirji so lahko ustavili nevarno delo, nihče ni smel na daljavo nadzorovati novorojenke, javni povratni koridor pa je povezoval kamnolom s starim trgom veleposlaništva za obiske, ki sta jih izbrala tako mesto kot otrok.
Suil in Kher sta položila roke ob Tethino na zapisovalniku. Pojavil se je vaelski znak priznanja: začasen, zakonit in preverljiv — prvi odgovor domačega sveta, ne zadnji.
Vey je priznal, kako blizu je bil, in topniško kodo predal v preiskavo.

**Teth**  
Bi streljali?

**Vey**  
Če bi se krilo obrnilo proti jugu.

**Teth**  
Verjamem vam.
To ni bilo prijateljstvo. Bilo je dovolj resnice za začetek naslednjih pogajanj.
Novorojenka je ob živih glasovih dvignila glavo. Njen tlačni ton je prečkal bazen in se vrnil od skale s Kherinim dolgim premorom v sebi.
Kher se je enkrat zasmejala, nato si pokrila obraz.

**Teth**  
Zapomnila si je obliko dobrodošlice.

**Illuminara**  
Zapomnila si je, da ji je ta odgovorila.
Eren je stopil do varnostne črte in zaklical svoje ime. Sunek je dvignil valovanje proti njegovim čevljem, ne da bi prečkal oznako.
Zaklical je materino ime. Odgovor se je vrnil drugačen.
Novorojenka ni ponavljala posnetka. Učila se je, da ime lahko kaže navzven in prejme odgovor.
Eno krilo je odprla proti Orisonu in ga pustila tako, dokler se zadnja oseba na razgledišču ni odločila, ali bo odgovorila.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara odkrije, da nerojeni otrok potrebuje svobodno odzivno navzočnost, ne ujetih teles, nato pa zaščiti premikajočo se dobrodošlico, ne da bi izbirala namesto Teth ali novorojenke; vseh devetsto gostov odide, mesto preživi, vaelske priče obred prenesejo ven, otrok pa dobi zakonit habitat s potjo nazaj.

Skupna bralska ocena ni prikazana. V dnevnem kazalu je prva razpoložljiva zgodba, ne zgodba izbrana po oceni. Zgodbo S2 je napisal in zaključil GPT kot nadomestilo za Claude.
